map.📖 查看「面积 × 辐照度 × 效率 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Area × Irradiance × Efficiency User Guide"
map.光伏输出功率：P = 组件面积 A（m²）× 辐照度 G（W/m²）× 组件效率: PV output power: P = module area A (m²) × irradiance G (W/m²) × module efficiency η; the actual system generation must also be multiplied by the system efficiency and converted by peak sunshine hours; for example, at the standard irradiance of 1000 W/m² a 2 m² module with 20% efficiency outputs about 400 W.
map.实际受温度与遮挡影响。: Actual results are affected by temperature and shading.
map.设计组串数量时核对阵列总功率与逆变器额定输入匹配。: When designing the number of strings, verify that the array total power matches the inverter's rated input.
map.估算高温环境下因温度系数导致的功率折减。: Estimate the power derating from the temperature coefficient in a high-temperature environment.
map.对比单晶/多晶/薄膜组件的单位面积功率差异。: Compare the power per unit area of monocrystalline/polycrystalline/thin-film modules.
map.10 块单晶 400 W 串联：STC 总功率 4000 W；环境温度 45℃、: 10 monocrystalline 400 W modules in series: STC total power 4000 W; at an ambient temperature of 45℃ with a 20℃ rise and a temperature coefficient of −0.35%/℃, the power derates by about 7% to about 3720 W. It is recommended that the inverter rating be slightly above 4000 W with an MPPT voltage window covering the string open-circuit voltage.
map.组件标称功率在什么条件下测的？: Under what conditions is the module rated power measured?
map.在 STC（辐照 1000 W/m²、电池温度 25℃、AM1.5）下测得，实际: Measured under STC (irradiance 1000 W/m², cell temperature 25℃, AM1.5); actual outdoor conditions are often below the rating due to high temperature and low irradiance, so leave a design margin.
map.为什么逆变器功率不必等于阵列功率？: Why doesn't the inverter power have to equal the array power?
map.因日照极少同时达 STC 且存在线损/失配，按阵列功率的 0.8–1.0 配逆变: Because sunlight rarely reaches STC simultaneously and there are line losses/mismatch, sizing the inverter at 0.8-1.0 of the array power balances cost and generation and avoids long-term light-load inefficiency.
